universities.name: Anna University
universities.summary: Anna University (AU) is a Tamil Nadu state university set up in 1978 at Guindy, Chennai, listed by UGC as a state university. It teaches engineering, technology, architecture, planning, management and science at four Chennai campuses (CEG, ACT, MIT and SAP), three regional campuses and 13 University Colleges of Engineering, and awards its own degrees.
universities.campusLifestyle: Anna University (AU)'s four Chennai campuses are College of Engineering Guindy (CEG, teaching since 1794), Alagappa College of Technology (ACT, 1944) and the School of Architecture and Planning (SAP, 1957), all on Sardar Patel Road, Guindy, and the Madras Institute of Technology (MIT) at Chromepet. Three regional campuses (Coimbatore, Madurai, Tirunelveli) and 13 University Colleges of Engineering across Tamil Nadu teach Anna University B.E./B.Tech. branches, and some offer MBA, MCA or M.E./M.Tech.
universities.cityProfile: Anna University (AU) is headquartered on Sardar Patel Road, Guindy, in south Chennai (PIN 600025), where CEG, ACT and SAP share one campus about 3 km from Guindy and Saidapet railway stations. The MIT campus is at Chromepet in Tambaram taluk, Chengalpattu district, 1 km from Chromepet station. Regional campuses are at Navavoor near Coimbatore, Keelakuilkudi in Madurai and Palayamkottai in Tirunelveli. University Colleges of Engineering are spread across Tamil Nadu, including Villupuram, Tindivanam, Arni, Kancheepuram, Tiruchirappalli (BIT Campus), Ariyalur, Thirukkuvalai, Panruti, Pattukkottai, Nagercoil, Thoothukudi, Ramanathapuram and Dindigul.
universities.practicalExposure: Anna University (AU) charges every B.E./B.Tech. entrant at the Chennai campuses a one-time placement and training fee of INR 2,000 and an industrial-visit fee of INR 500 a semester, according to its 2025-26 fee structures. In TNEA 2026 college data, the MIT campus reported 80 per cent placement and CEG 62 per cent; constituent colleges reported between 38 per cent (Ariyalur) and 85 per cent (Thirukkuvalai). M.E./M.Tech. programmes end in a project or thesis, and the M.Sc. Medical Physics leads to a 12-month AERB-recognised radiotherapy internship before the RSO examination.
universities.hostelOverview: Anna University (AU)'s CEG hostels charged UG students INR 42,625 at first-year entry in 2025-26, covering semester residential and maintenance charges, a mess advance of INR 17,500 and deposits. CEAP 2026 lists CEG and ACT hostels at INR 45,684 a year with mess of about INR 3,000 a month, MIT at INR 77,200 a year, and BIT Campus at INR 22,800 a year. Anna University runs separate international hostels, Flora for men and Lavender for women; foreign nationals get hostel details from the Centre for International Relations.
universities.dietarySupport: Anna University (AU)'s Chennai campus hostels serve both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, according to TNEA 2026 college data for CEG, ACT, SAP and MIT. Mess charges are billed separately from room rent: about INR 3,000 a month at CEG and ACT in CEAP 2026. No menu for specific religious or regional diets is published, so ask the hostel office before arrival.
universities.safetyOverview: Anna University (AU) lists an anti-ragging phone line for each campus in TNEA 2026 (CEG 044-2235 8491, MIT 99620 85868), and every Chennai entrant signs an anti-ragging declaration with a parent at admission. The university runs a POSH (prevention of sexual harassment) cell. Hostels have resident counsellors, including at the international hostels.
universities.studentSupport: Anna University (AU)'s Centre for Admissions handles foreign-national, NRI and CIWGC applications (FNRIcfa@gmail.com, 044-2235 8314), and the Centre for International Relations advises admitted international students on fees and hostels (admissions.cir@annauniv.edu). Indian entrants may claim the First Graduate tuition concession, the 7.5 per cent government-school waiver or the Post-Matric Scholarship.
whyChoose: Anna University (AU) is a UGC-listed state university (1978) whose Chennai campuses include CEG, teaching engineering since 1794, and MIT Chromepet, which reported 80 per cent placement in TNEA 2026 data.
Anna University's Chennai campuses charge Tamil Nadu students B.E./B.Tech. tuition of INR 6,000 a semester in regular programmes (2025-26), and foreign nationals pay USD 3,750 or 7,500 a year.

Anna University lists 31 B.E./B.Tech./B.Plan. programmes (2025-26) and 59 M.E./M.Tech./M.Arch./M.Plan. programmes (CEAP 2026) at its Chennai campuses, including rare fields such as Mining, Leather, Ceramic, Textile, Printing and Rubber and Plastics Technology.
thingsToConsider: Anna University (AU) admits Indian B.E./B.Tech. students only through TNEA, which requires Tamil Nadu schooling or nativity; foreign nationals have 5 per cent supernumerary seats per branch at the Chennai campuses and BIT Campus only.

Anna University's regional campuses and most University Colleges of Engineering have no foreign-national route and publish no tuition figure, and their placement rates in TNEA 2026 ranged from 38 to 85 per cent.
Anna University's B.Arch. at SAP could not be checked against the Council of Architecture's list for this page, and its B.E. Civil and Mechanical Tamil-medium branches are taught in Tamil.
bestFitFor: Tamil Nadu students with strong Class 12 Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry marks who want a low-fee engineering degree at CEG, ACT or MIT through TNEA.
Foreign nationals and LDC/SIDS citizens seeking an Indian state-university B.E./B.Tech. at USD 3,750 to 7,500 a year, or an M.E./M.Tech./MBA/MCA at USD 2,000 a year.
Engineering graduates with a CEETA-PG or GATE score looking for specialised M.E./M.Tech. programmes such as Avionics, Remote Sensing, Leather and Footwear or Industrial Safety.

faq.question: Is Anna University UGC approved?
faq.answer: Yes, Anna University (AU) is listed by the University Grants Commission as a state university, at Sardar Patel Road, Guindy, Chennai, with 1978 as its year. It awards its own degrees at its Chennai campuses (CEG, ACT, MIT and SAP), its regional campuses at Coimbatore, Madurai and Tirunelveli, and its University Colleges of Engineering. The Government of Tamil Nadu also authorises it to run TANCET and CEETA-PG.

faq.question: What is the B.E. fee at Anna University?
faq.answer: Anna University (AU)'s Chennai campuses charged Tamil Nadu B.E./B.Tech. students tuition of INR 6,000 a semester in regular programmes and INR 14,800 in self-supporting programmes in 2025-26, the latest published schedule. Other fees bring the semester total to about INR 15,200 or INR 25,000. Foreign nationals pay USD 7,500 a year for CSE, ECE, IT, VLSI and AI and Data Science, and USD 3,750 for other branches (2026-27).

faq.question: Does Anna University admit international students?
faq.answer: Yes, Anna University (AU) admits foreign nationals and citizens of Least Developed Countries and Small Island Developing States to 5 per cent supernumerary seats each in every B.E./B.Tech./B.Plan. branch at CEG, ACT, MIT, SAP and BIT Campus, and to 5 per cent of seats in its Chennai M.E./M.Tech., MBA, MCA and M.Sc. programmes. Apply at cfa.annauniv.edu/cfa; a valid student visa, PIO or OCI card is needed at admission.

faq.question: Which entrance exam does Anna University use?
faq.answer: Anna University (AU) fills Indian B.E./B.Tech. seats through TNEA on Class 12 marks, with no entrance test. M.E./M.Tech./M.Arch./M.Plan. use CEETA-PG (10 May 2026) or GATE, MBA and MCA use TANCET (9 May 2026), and the two-year M.Sc. uses Anna University's own entrance examination (7 June 2026). Foreign nationals are ranked on qualifying-exam marks.

faq.question: What is the fee for foreign students at Anna University?
faq.answer: Anna University (AU)'s 2026-27 fee for foreign nationals is USD 7,500 a year for B.E./B.Tech. CSE, ECE, IT and VLSI at CEG and CSE, ECE, IT and AI and Data Science at MIT, and USD 3,750 for other UG branches. All M.E./M.Tech./M.Arch./M.Plan., MBA, MCA and two-year M.Sc. programmes cost USD 2,000 a year, and the five-year M.Sc. USD 5,000. Applicants pay a USD 400 processing fee plus GST.

faq.question: Which colleges are part of Anna University?
faq.answer: Anna University (AU)'s own campuses are CEG, ACT and SAP at Guindy and MIT at Chromepet, the regional campuses at Coimbatore, Madurai and Tirunelveli, and 13 University Colleges of Engineering, including BIT Campus Tiruchirappalli and University V.O.C. College of Engineering, Thoothukudi. Hundreds of affiliated private colleges also award Anna University degrees, but they are separate institutions with their own fees.

faq.question: Does Anna University have hostels?
faq.answer: Yes, Anna University (AU) has hostels at its Chennai campuses, with vegetarian and non-vegetarian messes. CEG charged UG entrants INR 42,625 at first-year entry in 2025-26, and CEAP 2026 lists INR 45,684 a year at CEG and ACT plus mess of about INR 3,000 a month, and INR 77,200 a year at MIT. Separate international hostels (Flora for men, Lavender for women) house foreign students.

faq.question: How do I apply for M.E. or M.Tech. at Anna University?
faq.answer: Indian graduates apply to Anna University (AU) by taking CEETA-PG 2026 (or using GATE) and joining CEAP single-window counselling, which in 2026 listed 31 programmes at CEG, 12 at ACT, 4 at SAP, 12 at MIT and 5 at BIT Campus. CEAP 2026 lists yearly tuition of INR 50,400 (regular) or INR 75,400 (self-supporting) at CEG. Foreign nationals apply through cfa.annauniv.edu/cfa.

admissionsContent.overview: The B.E. Biomedical Engineering at College of Engineering Guindy (CEG) campus, Chennai is a four-year Anna University (AU) degree taught in English. Indian applicants are admitted through TNEA counselling on Class 12 marks, with no entrance test; foreign, NRI and CIWGC applicants apply to Anna University's Centre for Admissions.

eligibility.intro: TNEA 2026 sets these conditions for Indian applicants, and Anna University's 2026-27 FN and NRI instructions set the rules for international and NRI applicants.
items: Pass in HSC (Class 11 and 12, academic stream) or equivalent with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry
Minimum average in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry: 45 per cent (General) or 40 per cent (BC, BCM, MBC/DNC, SC/SCA/ST)
TNEA nativity rules apply: Tamil Nadu schooling for Classes 8 to 12, a Tamil Nadu nativity certificate, or another listed category
Foreign nationals: pass in Class 12 or equivalent (or an 8+4 or 9+3 foreign board) with at least 45 per cent in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry
Foreign nationals must hold a valid student visa, PIO or OCI card at admission and show six months of parental bank statements or a scholarship letter
NRI route: a parent or legal guardian must hold NRI status certified by the Indian embassy on or after 1 March 2026

applicationSteps: Indian applicants: register at tneaonline.org (fee INR 500, or INR 250 for SC/SCA/ST); TNEA 2026 registration ran 3 May to 5 June 2026
Upload Class 10, 11 and 12 mark sheets and any community, nativity or first-graduate certificates for online verification
Get a TNEA rank from Mathematics (100), Physics (50) and Chemistry (50), then choose college code 1 with branch BY in your counselling round
Confirm the allotment, pay the fee online and report to the campus with original certificates
Foreign national, LDC/SIDS, NRI or CIWGC applicants: apply online at cfa.annauniv.edu/cfa (processing fee USD 400 plus 18 per cent GST); 2026-27 applications ran 16 March to 15 June 2026
Join online choice filling in merit order (marks reduced to 200: Mathematics 100, Physics plus Chemistry 100) and pay the USD 1,000 initial deposit, adjusted against tuition

eligibility.intro: The TANCET/CEETA-PG 2026 brochure and CEAP 2026 set these conditions, and Anna University's 2026-27 FN instructions set the rules for foreign nationals.
items: Recognised bachelor's degree in the relevant discipline (B.E./B.Tech., B.Arch. or a prescribed master's) with at least 50 per cent (45 per cent for Tamil Nadu BC, BCM, MBC, SC, SCA, ST)
A valid CEETA-PG 2026 score, or a GATE score for GATE-category seats
The qualifying degree must match the eligible disciplines Anna University prescribes for this programme
Foreign nationals: a recognised bachelor's degree in the prescribed field with at least 50 per cent, ranked on degree marks or CGPA
Foreign nationals need a valid student visa, PIO or OCI card at admission, proof of financial support and evidence of English proficiency

applicationSteps: Register for CEETA-PG 2026 at tancet.annauniv.edu (examination fee INR 1,000, or INR 500 for SC/SCA/ST, plus counselling fee); the test was held on 10 May 2026
Apply for CEAP 2026 counselling and choose college code 1 with this programme; GATE-category seats are allotted first
Upload or present the CEETA-PG score card, degree certificate and mark sheets, pay the fee online at auegov.ac.in and report for admission
Foreign nationals: apply online at cfa.annauniv.edu/cfa (USD 400 plus GST processing fee; 14 May to 10 June 2026) and pay a USD 1,000 initial deposit at counselling

eligibility.intro: The TANCET/CEETA-PG 2026 brochure and CEAP 2026 set these conditions, and Anna University's 2026-27 FN instructions set the rules for foreign nationals.
items: Recognised bachelor's degree in the relevant discipline (B.E./B.Tech., B.Arch. or a prescribed master's) with at least 50 per cent (45 per cent for Tamil Nadu BC, BCM, MBC, SC, SCA, ST)
A valid CEETA-PG 2026 score, or a GATE score for GATE-category seats
The qualifying degree must match the eligible disciplines Anna University prescribes for this programme
Foreign nationals: a recognised bachelor's degree in the prescribed field with at least 50 per cent, ranked on degree marks or CGPA
Foreign nationals need a valid student visa, PIO or OCI card at admission, proof of financial support and evidence of English proficiency

applicationSteps: Register for CEETA-PG 2026 at tancet.annauniv.edu (examination fee INR 1,000, or INR 500 for SC/SCA/ST, plus counselling fee); the test was held on 10 May 2026
Apply for CEAP 2026 counselling and choose college code 2 with this programme; GATE-category seats are allotted first
Upload or present the CEETA-PG score card, degree certificate and mark sheets, pay the fee online at auegov.ac.in and report for admission
Foreign nationals: apply online at cfa.annauniv.edu/cfa (USD 400 plus GST processing fee; 14 May to 10 June 2026) and pay a USD 1,000 initial deposit at counselling

academic: Bachelor's degree certificate or provisional certificate
Consolidated or semester-wise degree mark sheets
application: CEETA-PG 2026 or GATE score card
Transfer certificate and community certificate where claimed
Foreign nationals: passport, student visa/PIO/OCI card, proof of financial support and English proficiency

admissionsContent.deadlinesNote: CEETA-PG 2026 was held on 10 May 2026. FN applications ran 14 May to 10 June 2026. First-semester PG classes at the Chennai campuses began on 9 July 2026.

programmes.mediumNote: Taught in English; foreign applicants must show English proficiency.
programmes.feeNotes: CEAP 2026 lists ACT, Guindy M.E./M.Tech./M.Arch./M.Plan. tuition of INR 40,400 a year for regular (aided) programmes (2026-27), plus other charges of INR 15,860 a year; hostel: INR 45,684 a year plus mess of about INR 3,000 a month. Foreign nationals pay USD 2,000 a year (2026-27).

teachingPhases.details: Anna University (AU) postgraduate curriculum at ACT, Guindy, ending in a project or thesis; regular programme.

additionalFees.notes: Anna University's 2026-27 FN instructions list USD 2,000 a year for all M.E./M.Tech./M.Arch./M.Plan. branches; a USD 1,000 initial deposit at counselling is adjusted against tuition.

programmes.officialTitle: M.Tech. Ceramic Technology, Alagappa College of Technology (ACT) campus, Chennai

fee.notes: CEAP 2026 lists ACT, Guindy M.E./M.Tech./M.Arch./M.Plan. tuition of INR 40,400 a year for regular (aided) programmes (2026-27), plus other charges of INR 15,860 a year; hostel: INR 45,684 a year plus mess of about INR 3,000 a month. Foreign nationals pay USD 2,000 a year (2026-27).

eligibleAudiences: Indian graduates with a CEETA-PG 2026 or GATE score
restrictions: CEETA-PG/CEAP seats are for Indian candidates; communal reservation applies only to Tamil Nadu natives
Foreign nationals enter only through Anna University's FN route (5 per cent of sanctioned seats per branch)
NRI and CIWGC candidates apply through separate Anna University quotas
audienceEligibility.notes: CEAP 2026 college code 2; approved intake 12; regular programme.
